tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description:
Daily weather summary for a point, from one or more international models.

    Returns, per model and per LOCAL day: mean and max wind (knots), max gust,
    dominant wind direction, min/max temperature, total precipitation, and peak
    CAPE. Not hour-by-hour — follow `solano_url` for the hourly vi

tools.name: get_confidence
tools.description:
How much the forecast can be trusted at this point, hour by hour, from
    ensemble spread — Solano's own indicator, not a raw model output.

    Each deterministic model is compared against the members of ITS OWN
    reference ensemble (GFS→GEFS, ECMWF IFS→ECMWF-ENS, ICON→ICON-EPS), never
    again

tools.name: get_storm_risk
tools.description:
Thunderstorm environment at a point, scored 0-10 per hour from convective
    ingredients rather than from a rain field.

    Built on a GFS baseline that carries the full set: CAPE sharpened by the
    lifted index, capped by convective inhibition, then modulated by the
    700-500 hPa lapse rate a

tools.name: get_marine_bulletin
tools.description:
The official marine forecast bulletin for the maritime zone containing a
    point — the text a national weather service publishes for mariners, not a

    AEMET (Spain), MeteoAM (Italy), Met Office (UK

tools.name: get_zone_alerts
tools.description:

    Met Office) plus European MeteoAlarm warnings resolved to the actual region,
